Subject: Your tenancy eviction matter - R.C.A. No. 1652/2020

Dear Ms. Bansal,

Thank you for meeting us on 6 December 2020 about your dispute with Rekha Naidu. As we understand it, the landlord is trying to evict the tenant after a rent increase was refused.

Our advice is to deposit the admitted rent in court to avoid an order striking off the defence. Please collect all rent receipts and the bank record of the rent deposited in court and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
